Thanks Tom — good color. A couple of quick finance-side adjustments I want to capture so forecasting uses a consistent approach:

• Probability assumptions: given SOC2 gating and the procurement review date (11/24), treat the opportunity as 40% until we have signed SOW + processed PO; increase to 85% once we have signed SOW and PO in-hand.
• Canary recognition: for the pilot ($60k), finance will recognize as "commit" for run-rate purposes only if procurement provides a PO or signed order form by 11/30. Otherwise it remains in best-case.
• ARR math: if pilot converts to reserved capacity at standard pricing, incremental ARR = $60k * 12 / 3 (prorated to annualized) => $240k ARR contribution; we will run sensitivity of 60/40 and 80/20 on that row for scenario planning.

I've attached a quick note with the assumptions so forecasting can pick these up. Laura — can you flag this in the weekly commit sheet and push a reminder to the SDR/AM to confirm PO status on 11/24? Neha — please ensure stage is "Procurement Review" and not advanced to "Commit" until PO + SOW are visible in HubSpot.

Attachment: [Attachment: Q4-risk-adjustment-notes.pdf (doc)]
